videos.title: US OPEN Champs On What LOSING Feels Like Compared to Winning | Djokovic, Sabalenka, Osaka
videos.description:
US Open champions don't win because they feel ready. They win because they've learned what to do when they don't.

Novak Djokovic, Naomi Osaka and Aryna Sabalenka talk about what happens inside a Grand Slam champion's head at the US Open, and why the calm you see on court is the last thing they're feeling.

They cover why Aryna Sabalenka refuses to watch the finals she lost, what Naomi Osaka was really going through when she walked away from the French Open, the two weeks Novak Djokovic spent on crutches before reaching a Wimbledon final, the definition of success that has nothing to do with trophies, why the pressure gets louder the closer you get to your dream, and the mind trick Djokovic uses when an entire stadium is cheering for the other guy.

Whether you're chasing something you've wanted for years, rebuilding after a loss, or trying to work out who you are outside the thing you're good at, this is the mental game behind US Open tennis that nobody teaches you.

What you'll learn in this episode:
What goes through a champion's mind before a Grand Slam final
Why Aryna Sabalenka never rewatches the matches she lost
How Naomi Osaka rebuilt her identity outside of tennis
Why fighting a nervous thought makes it stronger
What Novak Djokovic does with a crowd that's rooting against him
The definition of success that has nothing to do with winning
How to keep going when you love something and still don't want to show up
What losing a parent taught Aryna Sabalenka about pressure


Chapters:
0:00 — ARYNA SABALENKA · Winning the US Open twice in a row
0:50 — The two Grand Slam finals Aryna Sabalenka lost this season

17:04 — NAOMI OSAKA · Speaking up about mental health
18:29 — The blueprint Naomi Osaka's dad built from Richard Williams

22:48 — Reading the comments at 1am after the US Open final
23:26 — Who Naomi Osaka became after having her daughter

29:00 — When press conferences stopped feeling human

32:20 — Retiring Naomi Osaka's mom, and the goal that came next
35:00 — What Naomi Osaka was really going through at the French Open
39:24 — The courage to take a break and risk being forgotten
41:42 — NOVAK DJOKOVIC · The woman who shaped him
44:06 — Classical music, poetry and visualization at age 10

51:01 — How long can a 38-year-old Novak Djokovic keep playing
